statement.p: Serenity filled the gas tank in her car to {17\ {\rm gal}}\text{.} When the tank reaches {1\ {\rm gal}}\text{,} the low gas light will come on. On average, Serenitys car uses {0.048\ {\textstyle\frac{\rm\mathstrut gal}{\rm\mathstrut mi}}} per mile driven. How many miles will Serenitys car be able to drive before the low gas light comes on? Write an equation to model this scenario. There is no need to solve it.
